args.summary: I can't switch between your existing open tabs (no tab-management tool is available to me) — I can only act on the current tab or open a brand-new one. Please switch to your Netflix tab manually, or let me know if you'd like me to open netflix.com in a new tab instead.

content:
I don't have a tool that can switch between your existing open browser tabs — my available actions let me read/act on the current tab, open new background tabs, or navigate within a tab, but not bring an already-open tab (like Netflix) to the foreground.

A couple of options:
1. You can switch to it yourself (click the tab or use your browser's tab switcher/Ctrl+Tab).
2. If you'd like, I can open netflix.com in a new tab from here instead, though that would be a fresh tab rather than switching to your existing one.

Want me to open Netflix in a new tab?
